description: Resolve a conflict between TypedPath and OptionalFromRequestParts implementations where the wrong trait method is being called. Ensure that when both traits are used together, the correct FromRequestParts implementation is invoked to prevent compilation errors.
functional_requirements: Use fully qualified syntax to explicitly call FromRequestParts::from_request_parts method
Ensure the fix works when TypedPath and OptionalFromRequestParts traits are both implemented on the same type
Maintain backward compatibility with existing TypedPath usage patterns
